Iteration 5 adds:

1. MATCHUP SIMULATION ENGINE:
- POST /api/matchups/generate-schedule - Creates round-robin schedule (commissioner only)
- GET /api/matchups/{league_id} - Returns all matchups
- GET /api/matchups/{league_id}?week=1 - Filter by week
- GET /api/matchups/{league_id}/current-week - Returns current unplayed week
- POST /api/matchups/simulate-week - Simulates week using roster fantasy points (commissioner only)
- GET /api/matchups/{league_id}/results?week=1 - Returns completed matchups

- Generate Schedule button (commissioner only)
- Simulate Week button (commissioner only, appears after schedule generated)

All existing features (auth, leagues, teams, players, drafts, trades, waivers, roster, scoring) continue to work.
